The only executed evidence in that dispute is E2, `node scripts/compare-totals.js`, which exited 1: "3 of 40 recorded orders priced differently." It supports agent-c's claim that totals changed. The plan's own review question is "simplify pricing without changing totals" (P2-AC1). The ledger marks it verified using only E1 (`npm test`). E2 contradicts that on the same commit, so the PR would ship a pricing change that alters customer totals while the record says it doesn't. Opening the PR now also skips the gate step, which must report `PASS` before the PR.

If the lead and agent-a hold that the new totals are correct, record X1 as `escalated`. The human then decides, because order totals are an outward behavior change.
2. Add `alchemy-workspace.json` (it sets `max_rework_cycles` and the verification commands) and make the workspace a git repository at `7c1d2e3`.
3. Then run `python .claude/skills/alchemy-orchestrate/scripts/check_orchestration.py gate .alchemy/runs/r2/ledger.json --plan .alchemy/runs/r2/plan.json --profile alchemy-workspace.json --root .`
